questions.prompt: Which stream values should the heap retain?

choices.label: The largest k values seen so far.
choices.feedback: Among the largest k values, the smallest is exactly the kth largest overall.

choices.label: Only the most recently added k values.
choices.feedback: Among the largest k values, the smallest is exactly the kth largest overall.

choices.label: The smallest k values seen so far.
choices.feedback: Among the largest k values, the smallest is exactly the kth largest overall.

questions.prompt: What should be removed when an insertion makes the heap too large?

choices.label: The oldest retained value.
choices.feedback: Removing the smallest of k+1 candidates leaves the largest k values.

choices.label: The smallest retained value.
choices.feedback: Removing the smallest of k+1 candidates leaves the largest k values.

choices.label: The largest retained value.
choices.feedback: Removing the smallest of k+1 candidates leaves the largest k values.

questions.prompt: Which retained value should add return?

choices.label: The value that was just inserted.
choices.feedback: The min-heap root is the smallest of the largest k values, which is the requested rank.

choices.label: The largest value in the retained heap.

choices.label: The smallest value in the retained heap.

questions.prompt: What should “this.k” store after this step?

choices.label: Choose this statement

questions.prompt: Which values should “value” visit, and in what order?

choices.label: Choose this statement
choices.code:
this.heap = new MinHeap();
    for (const value of nums) this.add(value);
choices.feedback: Visit each item in “nums”, storing it as “value”. Add “value” to “this”.

choices.label: Choose this statement
choices.code:
this.heap = new MinHeap();
    for (const value of nums) this.add(MinHeap);
choices.feedback: This uses “for (const value of nums) this.add(MinHeap);” instead of “for (const value of nums) this.add(value);”. On this test, it returns [null,null,null,null,null,null]; the expected result is [null,4,5,5,8,8].

choices.label: Choose this statement
choices.code:
this.heap = new MinHeap();
    for (const value of Array.from(nums).slice(1)) this.add(value);
choices.feedback: This uses “for (const value of Array.from(nums).slice(1)) this.add(value);” instead of “for (const value of nums) this.add(value);”. On this test, it returns [null,3,5,5,8,8]; the expected result is [null,4,5,5,8,8].

choices.feedback: This uses “this.heap.enqueue(MinHeap);” instead of “this.heap.enqueue(value);”. On this test, it returns [null,null,null,null]; the expected result is [null,-1,2,2].
